event: Sanctions match (OFAC / EU / UK) on payment or customer
action: Block; escalate to MLRO; file with NCA; freeze account.

event: SAR / STR threshold met for a customer or transaction set
action: Investigate; file SAR; consider account closure.
Acknowledge; investigate; reimburse if PSR criteria met.
Suspend trader; preserve evidence; legal + HR review; MAR notification if confirmed.

event: Operational incident: outage > 30 minutes on critical service
action: DORA major-incident notification path; customer comms.
